params.name: filter.folderTypeId
params.description: The icon to display for the folder. Depricated in latest UI. Use 1 when setting this value.

params.name: filter.limitToDirectDescendents
params.description: When true and ParentFolderId is not null only return immediate child folders

params.name: filter.onlyIncludeRootFolders
params.description: When true only root folders will be returned and ParentFolderId will be ignored

params.name: filter.parentFolderId
params.description: Return folders that are descendants of this folder.

params.name: filter.permissionRequired
params.description: Specify whether to filter by Owner, Edit, AddSecret, View folder permission. Default is View.

params.name: filter.searchText
params.description: Search term to match against folder names. Search returns any folder where the search term is contained in the folder name.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip before taking results

params.name: sortBy[0].direction
params.description: Sort direction

params.name: sortBy[0].name
params.description: Sort field name

params.name: sortBy[0].priority
params.description: Priority index. Sorts with lower values are executed earlier

params.name: take
params.description: Maximum number of records to include in results
